description: This file defines the AOS_ContractsViewDetail class, which extends the ViewDetail class to provide customized display features for contract details within SuiteCRM. It includes methods for populating a list of PDF templates, rendering a popup for template selection, and integrating these features into the contract detail view.

classes.name: AOS_ContractsViewDetail
classes.description: Class extending ViewDetail to customize display of contract details, including template selection and popup HTML rendering.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Overrides parent display method to populate templates and show popup HTML.

methods.name: populateContractTemplates
methods.description: Fetches active PDF templates related to contracts and populates a global list for dropdown display.

methods.name: displayPopupHtml
methods.description: Generates HTML and JavaScript for displaying a popup to select and generate PDFs based on templates.
